notes.title: Pastopia Demo Version Is Live! 📢
notes.notes:
Dear Walkers,

After two years of development, we’re thrilled (jumping on all fours like an excited puppy!!!) to release the Demo Version of Pastopia in conjunction with this June’s Steam Next Fest! 

If you’ve followed us since the days we were on itch.io or have visited us at various game events, we sincerely can’t thank you enough for supporting us throughout this journey. 

We’re always looking for ways to make Pastopia better, so shoot us a message in our Google Forms if you encounter any issues, bugs, or just want to hurl us gems of feedback. We’d love to know what you think about the game! (Your insights would mean the world to us ദ്ദി ꒦ິ꒳꒦ິ )✧)

We hope Pastopia brings your creativity to new heights and that you have lots of fun exploring and coding! <3

The forgotten memories of Pastopia await you!
